goal: Classify changes without granting execution authority; separately track and attest verified maintenance deliveries.
acceptance: Version-one submissions retain their canonical identity and existing records migrate without data loss.
Feature executors cannot edit control-plane files, claim maintenance work, or elevate scope through submitted metadata.
Maintenance completion requires actual full machine reports, independent approval of the same source, verified dependencies, and a commit on the enrolled target.
Rejected or duplicate attestations cannot create a completed run.
nodeChecks: versioned change kinds preserve legacy identity and reject client execution authority
control-plane paths are protected independently of a task declaration
maintenance issues remain separately queued and cannot run through the feature executor
owner maintenance records only an independently approved verified merged source
execution: Use the separate owner maintenance workflow. This record is not a feature-executor task and grants no write scope.
